officialSources.publisher: Government of Uttar Pradesh / Board of Revenue
officialSources.observation: Kasganj tehsil report lists 245 revenue villages, 205 scanned/verified/linked villages, 204 georeferenced villages, and 269 cadastral map sheets with 267 georeferenced; this establishes active cadastral-map digitization but not city boundary coverage or an open feature API.

officialSources.publisher: Government of Uttar Pradesh / Board of Revenue
officialSources.observation: Kasganj tehsil detail report exposes village-level map digitization status and includes Kasganj urban/locality rows; the report is tabular status evidence, not parcel geometry.

officialSources.publisher: Government of Uttar Pradesh / Board of Revenue
officialSources.observation: Official Bhulekh portal provides land-record services including khatauni, khasra, plot/gata status and links to bhu-naksha.
District page identifies the concerned tehsil revenue office in Kasganj and links to the Board of Revenue.

officialSources.publisher: National Informatics Centre / Department of Land Resources
officialSources.observation: National Bhu-Naksha landing page describes parcel-map management for authorized state/UT officials; it does not expose Kasganj data or an anonymous public geometry endpoint.

requests.outcome: Direct curl request timed out after 20 seconds; web fetch also timed out. No conclusion about source absence.
Public report read successfully; Kasganj district and Kasganj tehsil rows were returned with digitization counts.
Kasganj tehsil village-level report returned; rows include Kasganj localities, but no parcel polygon or machine-readable geometry endpoint was exposed.
Landing page was discoverable, but direct fetch did not yield a bounded anonymous parcel response or public service schema.
Official host was identified through first-party/officially referenced discovery, but no public anonymous API/schema or geometry response was captured. No login, CAPTCHA, or bypass was attempted.
National Bhu-Naksha informational landing page returned; it states the system is intended for authorized officials and did not provide Kasganj parcel geometry.

registryBasis: Official Uttar Pradesh revenue sources evidence a Kasganj tehsil cadastral-map/land-record program and a Kasganj tehsil revenue custodian. This is registry/cadastre-service evidence only; no city-bounded parcel geometry or public API schema was verified.
